# Generate matching Phrase and C# codebases of 1, 10 and 50 endpoints
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #119, sha256:8bf6b4fb733dbd44f3dfe358398a4906fffe3b82625cc7a8bbd0404b4d63cf7a). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Done 2026-10-27 (commit f9d78eb, authored by Grok; deterministic generator of matching Phrase and C# codebases of 1, 10 and 50 endpoints with shared outcomes and context-dependent tasks; Decider D85 passed; the plain C# side must be rewritten in ordinary style by card 130 before card 120)
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** feature (thin slice; a deterministic generator)
- **Milestone:** Codebase size: does Phrase's cost fall and its edge widen as the codebase grows?
- **Source:** Steve's idea relayed by Dispatch, 2026-10-27 (test against different code base sizes; use his real projects as the medium and large codebases) and Decider D82 (Codex, Grok Support-it; Copilot Yes). A separate question beside the frozen bar (D32); no frozen number changes and no stored row is re-scored.
- **Depends on:** 111
- **Story:** As Riley, I want a generator that makes matching Phrase and plain C# codebases of 1, 10 and about 50 endpoints from one template, so that codebase size can be varied without porting anything by hand.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given a size N of 1, 10 or 50, When the generator runs with a fixed seed, Then it writes a Phrase codebase and a plain C# codebase of N endpoints with shared types and leaf phrases, byte-identical on a second run, and each Phrase codebase compiles with the C# adapter and passes its generated specs
  2. Given the two codebases of a size, When the C# one is built and its xUnit tests run, Then it builds without warnings and its tests pass, and both versions have equal outcome cases (an outcomes.json per task shared by both)
  3. Given the generator, When it makes the modify and fix tasks, Then each task needs context from a file other than the one it changes (a test names the dependency) and the starting code of the changed file is the same size class in both arms

## Context

- Public and synthetic: invented domains only. Output goes to a temp or git-ignored folder; tests use size 1 and 10 to stay fast.
- Tier S of Decider D82.
